items.originalTitle: Antonelli wins United States GP but made to wait for world title
detailZh: 美国大奖赛：基米·安东内利赢得奥斯汀赛事，凭借出色的驾驶将有望成为F1历史上最年轻的世界冠军。
基米·安东内利在美国大奖赛中获胜。
基米·安东内利凭借出色的驾驶在美国大奖赛中获胜，将有望成为F1历史上最年轻的世界冠军。
安东内利有在周日奥斯汀的比赛中赢得2026年冠军的外部机会，前提是他必须获胜，刘易斯·汉密尔顿排名前四之外，乔治·拉塞尔排名第九或更低。
尽管他通过一次停站策略，以出色的表现赢得了本赛季的第9场胜利，领先最近的竞争对手两个位置，汉密尔顿获得了第四名，拉塞尔获得第八名，以保持数学上的竞争可能性。

但安东内利已经领先拉塞尔123分，领先汉密尔顿124分，本赛季剩余最多125分可以争夺，下周日在墨西哥城的F1大奖赛加冕几乎不可避免。
基米·安东内利在美国大奖赛中取得了飞跃性的开局，乔治·拉塞尔被处以五秒罚时
安东内利今年八月才满20岁，这是他F1的第二赛季，如果他在墨西哥站结束前四轮比赛中获得前九名中的任何一个位置，他将锁定冠军
安东内利以13秒的优势获胜，查尔斯·勒克莱尔在对抗红牛的马克斯·维斯塔潘的两次停站策略对决中，为法拉利赢得了精彩的第二名
查尔斯·勒克莱尔在兰多·诺里斯和马克斯·维斯塔潘之间完成了两次精彩的超越。
汉密尔顿排名第四，仅落后维特斯班恩一秒，兰多·诺里斯采用单停策略获得第五名。
在其他梅赛德斯车队中，拉塞尔艰难的周末和赛季以第八名的成绩结束，他的比赛因第一圈与奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里的碰撞而受到五秒罚时的影响。拉塞尔在维修区服刑后落后于澳大利亚人，并且无法找到超越的方法。
红牛车队两辆赛车都出现了技术问题，维特斯班恩承认赛车‘无法驾驶’。
一级方程式赛车锦标赛接下来将南下进行三连赛的第二站，墨西哥城大奖赛将于10月30日至11月1日举行，由天空体育F1频道直播。通过NOW观看天空体育，无需签订合同，可随时取消。

detailEn: United States GP: Kimi Antonelli wins Austin race to move to brink of F1 world title after dominant drive
Kimi Antonelli took the win at the United States Grand Prix
Kimi Antonelli moved to the brink of becoming Formula 1's youngest-ever world champion with a superb drive to victory in the United States Grand Prix.
Antonelli had an outside chance of clinching the 2026 title as early as Sunday's Austin race provided he won, Lewis Hamilton finished outside the top four and George Russell was ninth or lower.

And while he held up his side of the bargain by brilliantly claiming a ninth win of the season on a one-stop strategy to his nearest rivals' two, Hamilton took fourth and Russell eighth to stay in mathematical contention.
United States GP race result | F1 2026 standings | F1 2026 calendar

But Antonelli has moved 123 points clear of Russell, and 124 points clear of Hamilton, with just a maximum of 125 left to play for this season to make a coronation at next Sunday's Mexico City Grand Prix all-but inevitable.
Kimi Antonelli got a flying start at the United States Grand Prix as George Russell was handed a five-second penalty
Antonelli, who only turned 20 in August and is in his second season of F1, will clinch the title with four rounds to go in Mexico if he finishes anywhere in the top nine.
Antonelli won by 13 seconds with Charles Leclerc finishing a fine second for Ferrari after winning out against Red Bull's Max Verstappen in the battle of two-stop strategies.
Charles Leclerc makes two great overtakes on Lando Norris and Max Verstappen.
Hamilton was fourth, just a second behind Verstappen, with Lando Norris fifth on a one-stop strategy.

In the other Mercedes, Russell's difficult weekend, and season, was summed up by his eighth-place finish, his race compromised by a five-second penalty for an incident with Oscar Piastri on the first lap. Russell dropped behind the Australian after serving his penalty at his pit stop and was unable to find a way back past.
Both Red Bulls suffer technical issues as Max Verstappen admits car is 'undriveable'.
